description: Spend ledger with reservations: one budget for a tree of agents — A budget shared by a task tree, in integer minor units. Call open(currency, budgetMinor) once per ledger first; every other op answers unknown NO_LEDGER until then. reserve() atomically holds an amount if the remaining budget covers it (expired holds are freed automatically); commit() records what was actually spent, up to the hold; release() frees a hold. These are real reservations, not a snapsh

amountMinor.description: reserve: amount to hold. commit: amount actually spent (at most the hold).

budgetMinor.description: open: total budget in minor units.

currency.description: open: currency or token code, e.g. USD or USDC.

requestId.description: Caller-chosen id for this mutation. A retry with the same id and same input returns the stored response (24 h) instead of applying twice; the same id with different input is rejected. Send one on every mutation you may retry: without it a retry is applied again (fleet-memory record appends a duplicate; a repeated spend-ledger commit or release answers NO_HOLD because the first call already took effect).

tenantId.description: Required for API-key callers (namespaced as key:<tenantId>; keep it unguessable). Ignored when a wallet paid: the payer address is the tenant.

name: spend-ledger
